title: A la mesa
subtitle: Sitting down to dinner
scene: Dinner is ready. Everyone gathers around the table.

lines.en: Time to eat! Everyone to the table.

lines.note: Pozole: a hominy stew with pork or chicken, a favorite for family gatherings.

culture.title: Provecho
culture.text: Say “¡Provecho!” or “¡Buen provecho!” when the food is served, and even to strangers eating as you walk past. It’s very Mexican.

lines.note: Te gusta = you like (literally: it pleases you).

lines.en: Yes, but just a little, please.
lines.note: Mexicans love -ito endings: poquito = a tiny bit. It sounds friendly.

lines.en: Ha ha! Very good. Just a little.
